$description: Read-only seven-layer Token count report. Counts distinguish authored source entries, sparse Component source paths and expanded Runtime output; this report is not a Token source.

countDefinitions.primitiveProfileThemeSemantic: leaf nodes with $type and $value; Theme mode overrides reported separately
countDefinitions.composite: governed composite role/record entries, because Composite packages intentionally store structured members rather than one flat $type leaf per package
countDefinitions.content: localized Content Catalog entries and supported locales; Content is not a visual Token layer
countDefinitions.component: compiler-calculated sparse authored component paths after Base, Composite/Content boundaries and overrides are resolved
countDefinitions.runtime: compiler-generated legal combination and overlay output
countDefinitions.figma: read-only platform audit evidence only; never inferred from Runtime output

runtimeDeduplicationAnalysis.interpretation: Runtime paths preserve component/axis/state/slot semantics; repeated references are expected and are not automatically removable.
runtimeDeduplicationAnalysis.resolutionScope: primitive/profile/theme/semantic aliases that can be resolved by the current audit script; Composite structured members are not flattened into this number

platformEvidence.warning: Observed Figma variables are not the V2 source count and must not be used as the architecture baseline.

knownLimitations: Gradient, Shadow and Blur packages are structurally registered but contain no active governed records.
Content Catalog has locale policy but no concrete entries yet.
Tree is not included in the confirmed component subtotal because it still lacks an independent Component Contract.
Figma/Pixso current variable counts require platform-side read-only measurement and are not compiler-derived.
